item.title: PGA Tour schedule: The Players Championship 2025: How to watch, streams, field and prize money
item.description: TV times and more for The Players Championship, March 12-15 in Ponte Vedra Beach, Florida.

item.title: Arnold Palmer Invitational 2026: Tee times, pairings and how to watch Round 3
item.description: The 72-player signature event field has been cut after 36 holes at Bay Hill Club and Lodge. Here's how to watch third round coverage of the Arnold Palmer Invitational.

item.title: 'They're already dead': Scottie Scheffler among those feeling mercilessness of Bay Hill's greens
item.description: Despite sitting T-15, Scheffler was left demonstrably frustrated by Friday afternoon at the Arnold Palmer Invitational, as he'd seen enough of Bay Hill's lightning-quick, borderline, nearly purply greens.

item.title: Scheffler hits range after posting 71 at Arnold Palmer Invitational
item.description: Scottie Scheffler recorded 10 consecutive pars on Friday at Bay Hill in route to a 1-under 71 for the second round. Scheffler sits 10 strokes off API leader Daniel Berger entering the weekend.

item.title: Lowry makes bold play off the rocks to try and make API cut
item.description: Shane Lowry needed to par the final hole to make the cut at the 2026 Arnold Palmer Invitational. After hitting his approach shot into the rock bed on 18, he took on the challenge to try and make a '4'.

item.title: Daniel Berger leads 'U.S. Open in spring' by five shots at Bay Hill
item.description: Berger followed his opening 63 with a 68 Friday at Bay Hill to move five shots clear of Akshay Bhatia through 36 holes.

item.title: PGA Tour highlights 2026: Puerto Rico Open, Round 2
item.description: Chandler Blanchet leads the field at Grand Reserve Golf Club by four strokes. Gordon Sargent sits in a solo second, while a pair of amateurs are making a splash in Rio Grande. John Daly II shot a 5-under 67 on Friday and sits T-7. Fellow amateur Kihei Akina recorded three birdies during his second round and is T-12 entering the weekend.

item.title: Best of Happy Hour with Smylie at 2026 Arnold Palmer Invitational
item.description: Jacob Bridgeman and Chris Gotterup joined Smylie Kaufman to talk about their friendship and success on PGA Tour this year. Bridgeman, fresh off his win at the Genesis Invitational, spoke about shaking hands with Tiger Woods. Gotterup, the Sony Open and WM Phoenix Open winner, hosted Bridgeman and his wife during last week as the two golfers prepped for the Arnold Palmer Invitational. Check out the best moments from this "Happy Hour with Smylie presented by Michelob Ultra."

item.title: Blanchet leads in Puerto Rico as John Daly II stays in the mix
item.description: Making his PGA Tour debut, John Daly II played a bogey-free round on Friday. He enters the weekend tied for seventh and six shots behind leader Chandler Blanchet.

item.title: PGA Tour highlights 2026: Arnold Palmer Invitational, Round 2
item.description: Akshay Bhatia shot a Friday-best 6-under 66 and ascended to solo second on the Bay Hill Club leaderboard. He sits five strokes off leader Daniel Berger. Rickie Fowler, Rory McIlroy and Sahith Theegala all enjoyed strong second round performances at the Arnold Palmer Invitational.
